market_read: Week 15 snapshot: 10 verified rows (0 new, 10 persisting, 0 gone), 0 indicative. The dataset has been fully static for two consecutive weeks — no new listings entered, no listings departed, and no prices changed. Verified range PHP 269–2,800/sqm; dataset median PHP 1,750/sqm (midpoint of 5th and 6th rows sorted by price per sqm); Pagsanjan-core holds 4 rows (PHP 850–2,000/sqm, core median PHP 1,300/sqm). Ring municipalities cluster PHP 1,500–2,800/sqm except for the Pila Mojon outlier at PHP 269/sqm (now in its fifteenth week unchanged, suggesting a price that has not attracted buyers at this level either). A notable signal this week: a third agent listing for the same Sisilmin/Caliraya parcel appeared tagged under Lumban at PHP 18,500,000 and explicitly disclosed a price reduction from PHP 23,500,000 — the seller has now cut the ask by 21% versus the original price, yet the original agent's listing at PHP 23,503,200 remains live simultaneously. For a raw 0.5–1 ha Pagsanjan parcel, recommended asking range PHP 1,400–1,800/sqm; fastest-sale price PHP 900–1,000/sqm. With no new confirmed exits this week, pricing signal from cleared inventory remains limited to the single prior Bulilan Norte exit at PHP 2,000/sqm.
